neighbours.label: the tokens ' distinct' / ' distinctly' (weaker: ' decidedly') in the sense 'marked, unmistakable'
fire: The new mayor brings a distinct style to city hall.
Critics said there was a distinct possibility of a strike.
The cheese has a distinct smell of smoke and hay.
Her accent was distinctly Scottish even after years abroad.
He distinctly heard someone call his name from the yard.
The mood in the room was decidedly gloomy after the vote.
The island has three distinct seasons and a long dry spell.
Voters felt a distinct lack of enthusiasm for either candidate.
quiet: The new mayor brings a fresh style to city hall.
Critics said there was a clear possibility of a strike.
The cheese has a strong smell of smoke and hay.
Her accent was noticeably Scottish even after years abroad.
He plainly heard someone call his name from the yard.
The mood in the room was rather gloomy after the vote.
The island has three separate seasons and a long dry spell.
Voters felt a definite lack of enthusiasm for either candidate.

notes: Card: ' distinct' x18, ' distinctly' x7, ' decidedly' x3 of top 32. Probes: distinct 0.91, distinctly 0.66, decidedly 0.42; but 'a clear chance' 0.38 and 'markedly' 0.20, so near-synonyms leak and the near misses below use them on purpose.
